notes.title: MFL Fanatics Newsletter (September 2025)
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/37cdb7e3a012430949ce065524c9509b9a9f5197.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]MFL2 SEASON OPENER EDITION: September 2025[/b][/h2][p][b]Happy New Football Season[/b] to everyone,[/p][p align="start"]​[/p][p align="start"]It’s September! Which means a new football season has kicked off — that makes it the perfect time to huddle up for another Mutant Football League 2 update! Just like your favorite undead linebacker, this newsletter is back from the grave to get you up to speed on the latest news, feature updates, and tackle some of the biggest questions you’ve been throwing our way.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]RELEASE NEWS![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/85a0881d110bb2137085f00f22f34d05e1758cc0.jpg"][/img]We’ve been saying [i]Mutant Football League 2[/i] is launching in Fall 2025, and the #1 question we keep getting is: “What’s the exact date?”[/p][p align="start"]​[/p][p align="start"]The official launch date is…  — REDACTED —[/p][p align="start"]​​[/p][p align="start"]Yeah, we know—that’s brutal. But here’s the deal: we can’t spill it here without undercutting our official announcement, which we want the gaming press to cover (and more coverage = more eyeballs = more games sold and more mayhem). What we [i]can[/i] tell you is that the game is absolutely dropping late Fall—so stay tuned, because the big reveal is coming very soon.
[/p][h2][b]FEATURE NEWS[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/fe284e39331141ae5c643edc6f784e0ec854a399.png"][/img]The most talked-about feature in [i]Mutant Football League 2[/i] has been Dynasty Supreme, our franchise mode. The big questions from the community have been: When is it coming out? Will we get to play it in Early Access or Game Preview before full release?[/p][p align="start"]​[/p][p align="start"]We hope so — but we can’t promise anything just yet. Dynasty Supreme is the game’s biggest feature, with hundreds of sub-systems packed inside. There’s nothing we want more than to put this in the hands of our Beta testers, but it’s just not ready. The good news: we’re close. If all goes well, we’re targeting a release for Beta testing within the next few weeks.[/p][p align="start"]​​[/p][h3][b]League Structure[/b][/h3][p]Here’s what we can confirm: Dynasty Supreme introduces a new league structure featuring 32 parody teams, split into two conferences — Blood and Guts — with four divisions (East, West, North, South) in each, just like the NFL.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/16b9bff4d3611cee5ae183bf62fc50dd1f5f5a99.jpg"][/img][b]BLOOD CONFERENCE[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]EAST[/b][/p][list][*][p]Nuked London Hatriots[/p][/*][*][p]Snuffalo Thrills[/p][/*][*][p]Diami Krakens[/p][/*][*][p]New Yuck Threats[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][list][*][p][b]NORTH[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blitzburgh Steelheads[/p][/*][*][p]Leaveland Burns[/p][/*][*][p]Brawltimore Razors[/p][/*][*][p]Sinsonasty Manglers[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]WEST[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lost Wages Invaders[/p][/*][*][p]Mile High Chronic[/p][/*][*][p]Karcass City Creeps[/p][/*][*][p]Los Scandalous Volts[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]SOUTH[/b][/p][list][*][p]Insane Cults[/p][/*][*][p]Hexxon Oilers[/p][/*][*][p]Gnashville Lycans[/p][/*][*][p]Cracksumskull Jugulars[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]GUTS CONFERENCE[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]EAST[/b][/p][list][*][p]Malice Hellboys[/p][/*][*][p]Killadelphia Evils[/p][/*][*][p]Brainwashington Cadavers[/p][/*][*][p]New Yuck Tyrants[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]NORTH[/b][/p][list][*][p]Midway Mutants[/p][/*][*][p]Motor City Maniacs[/p][/*][*][p]Grim Bay Attackers[/p][/*][*][p]Purple Mutant Eaters[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]​[/p][list][*][p][b]WEST[/b][/p][list][*][p]Microhard Mutilators[/p][/*][*][p]Cardinal Sins[/p][/*][*][p]Sin Fransicko Forty Nightmares[/p][/*][*][p]Los Scandalous Damned[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]​[/p][list][*][p][b]SOUTH[/b][/p][list][*][p]Scarolina Panzers[/p][/*][*][p]Deadlanta Vultures[/p][/*][*][p]New Goreleans Zombies[/p][/*][*][p]Terror Bay Mutanteers[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p]All of these teams will be available at launch![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Player Drafts[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/1c25b2c413ee491f4dbc7716572b1d1cdc1b0991.jpg"][/img]Each new season in Dynasty Supreme begins with a player draft. You’ll draft 7 rookies who are more cost-efficient than veterans, helping balance your roster over time. Drafting is a cornerstone of the mode — and yes, it’s been the “bugaboo” slowing down our Beta release. Our engineers are grinding hard to iron this out, and we expect it to be solved soon.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Economy[/b][/h3][p]Dynasty Supreme’s economy is split into two systems:[/p][list][*][p][b]Salary Cap[/b]: The maximum you can spend on player contracts. Trades and Free Agent signings count toward the cap. If you hit the limit, you’ll need to cut pricey veterans to free space. Unused cap rolls over each season.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Team Funds[/b]: Money earned and spent while playing. Win games to earn funds, spend them to resurrect dead players. Funds also roll over each season, separate from the cap.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]SEASON PREDICTIONS[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/036b498f0e01e2a1e210497f557d095d38266b65.png"][/img]Now it’s your turn—who’s your Mayhem Bowl pick? Drop your predictions in the [url="https://discord.gg/mfl"][u]Discord[/u][/url] or [url="https://www.facebook.com/MutantFootballLeague/"][u]Facebook[/u][/url], and let’s see who’s still alive by playoff time.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]QUESTIONS & ANSWERS[/b][/h2][p][b]Q: What is the full game release date for all platforms?[/b]
A: The official announcement is coming soon. Xbox Series X, PS5, and PC (Steam) will all launch simultaneously.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Q: Will there be a roster update for MFL1?[/b]
A: No — all focus is now on MFL2.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Q: When will Dynasty Supreme be released for Early Access?[/b]
A: That’s the plan — fingers crossed![/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Q: Are fantasy teams returning to MFL2?[/b]
A: Yes! Both fan favorites and brand-new fantasy teams are coming. We’ll announce them soon.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Q: Will MFL2 have online crossplay at launch?[/b]
A: Not at launch, but we’re planning to add it shortly after release.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Q: Where are the Werewolves, Aliens, and Demons?[/b]
A: In MFL1 we had a variety of species, but they all looked nearly identical. With MFL2, we wanted every player to look unique — different hairstyles, facial hair, mutations, tattoos, gear, etc. Since we’re a small, self-funded team, we had to reduce the total number of species at launch. That doesn’t mean aliens or other creatures will never show up.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Q: What’s the plan for post-release content?[/b]
A: Right now, our focus is on shipping the game in late Fall. Post-launch, you can expect more fantasy teams and online crossplay first.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]BETA TEST PROGRAMS[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/463ffe75b43dfa258ad6b5603b27ef2c1627c159.png"][/img]A huge thank you to everyone who joined our Steam Early Access and Xbox Games Preview programs. So many of you reported bugs, sent feedback, and suggested features — your support is helping shape [i]Mutant Football League 2[/i]. Without you, this game simply wouldn’t be possible.[/p][p align="start"]​[/p][p align="start"]To our Elite Test Team: your dedication and ideas from day one have been incredible. Your unique player characters will be in the game before launch. You guys rock![/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Thanks to the People Pounding Away in Kyiv[/b][/p][p align="start"]Finally, we want to recognize [b]our incredible teammates in Kyiv[/b], who continue working through bombings, air raid sirens, and power outages. Your resilience and dedication inspire us every day. Our hearts are with you, and we all pray this war ends soon.[/p][p align="start"]​​[/p][h2][b]Found a bug or have a suggestion?[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Join the [url="https://discord.gg/mfl"][u][b]Official MFL Discord[/b][/u][/url] server today to share feedback, report bugs, suggest ideas, find other MFL Fanatics, and stay up-to-date on all MFL topics: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/mfl"]https://discord.gg/mfl[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]To all our fans, testers, and diehard MFL Fanatics — [b]Thank you[/b] for sticking with us and helping shape this mutanted monster of a game. We can’t wait to unleash it late Fall. Until then… Create. Mutate. Dominate.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/8a557e958a637cb2b673410d38fb69792f555521.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: [Update] November 8, 2024
[Update] November 1, 2024
Upcoming Update Question for the Community
notes.content:
ːdialogbubbleːHey [b]MFL2 Steam Community[/b]!

We’re gearing up for our next update and the release of new teams, and we’d love to get your feedback on an ideaːwinter2019happybulbː we’re considering.

In the past, we’ve only released teams with completed customization and finalized playbooks. However, we now have all 32 teams with rosters and ratings readyːcrateː — though about 12 of them still need their personalizationːcool_seagullː and playbooksːSocialPolicyː.

ːdialogbubbleːSo here’s the question: Would you be interested in seeing all 32 teams in the game now, even if some are still a work in progress? We’d make it clear which teams are unfinished, and this way, you could jump into a full 17-game season mode with all conferences and divisions in place. Plus, we’d love to hear your feedback on your gameplay experience! As time goes on, we’ll add the final touches to those remaining teams.

We’re here to listen! If you’d rather wait for each team to have finalized ːGemsːcustomizationːcool_seagullː and playbooksːSocialPolicyː, just let us know, and we’ll stick with the original release planːdragonsealː.

One more update: Our October release is coming on Friday, November 1st, 2024! Expect to see:
[list]
     [*] a new character (our work-in-progress ːknightsarmourːrobotːpaperdeathː);
     [*] 4 new teams;
     [*] part of the RPO feature, including Play Action plays.
[/list]

Looking forward to hearing your thoughts and seeing you in the game! Thanks again to all of you for being part of the [b]MFL2 [i]Early Access[/i][/b] journey.


[b]Thank you,
DDE Team[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/55ecc74f075ba7301b4e61decaf02a183487f87c.png[/img]

notes.title: MFL Fanatics Newsletter (October 2024)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/2abf8ba303d695e9f35bc7882479c651d3cb482d.png[/img]
[h2]Welcome to the MFL Fanatics ːtelegramːNewsletter![/h2]
We’ve missed youːpraisesunː, and we’re back to bring you the latest updates, answer your questions, and give you a sneak peek at what’s coming next in the insane world of [i][b]Mutant Football League[/b][/i]!ːlove_seagullː

[h2]MFL1 Rosters Updated for the 2024 Season![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/f0f0c5a59055bfda56dfa0d9b91f7a7f45dfaf3e.png[/img]
That’s right! MFL1 just got a fresh roster update for the 2024 season, with all-new rookie players, updated ratings, and rosters. Plus, we’re running some sweet sales leading up to ːOrcHateː[b]Halloween[/b]! Know someone who’d love [i][b]MFL[/b][/i]’s crazy arcade-style football? Now’s the time to gift them the game—they’ll be thinking of you every time they unleash chaos on the field!
ːdialogbubbleː"But wait," you ask, "I thought you weren’t updating MFL1 this year?" Well, read on...ːwinter2019happybulbː

[h2]MFL2 Release Status[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/3c6727d0abb3055bffed6d11625ea06c977507a3.jpg[/img]
We originally planned to release [b]MFL2[/b] this fall, but the truth is, we’re still hard at work making it the best game it can be. To keep our core features and high standards intact, we’ve pushed the release to [b]Fall 2025[/b].
Now, for the serious part... It’s been an incredibly challenging year for our team. While some members have safely relocated to places like Spain, Sweden, and Chicago, others remain in Kyiv, where they face ongoing power outages and missile attacks. In all my years of game development, I’ve seen plenty of ups and downs, but nothing compares to the hardships our team is enduring now.
The realities of war have made game development more unpredictable and risky than ever, but our small team—many of whom have been with us since the beginning—continues to push forward. They are more than just colleagues; they are family, and we are deeply grateful for their unwavering dedication and bravery. Despite the extreme circumstances, they remain focused on moving this project forward, and we couldn’t be prouder of their resilience.

[h2]Steam Early Access Status[/h2]
ːdialogbubbleːWe wanted to have a section in this Newsletter for our [b]Early Access Steam[/b] players. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1657320/Mutant_Football_League_2/

We use [b]Early Access[/b] as a test bed. A place where we can try some standard and risky things before the game is released. People play it and give us feedback and suggestions. We quickly learn what they like or don’t and make adjustments.
ːsotchestːHere are some of the new features we’ll be adding to [i][b]MFL2[/b][/i] in [b]Early Access Steam[/b] in October.

[h3]Our new ːpaperdeathːrobot character[/h3]
This metallic menace is making its way to the gridiron. He’s still missing some armor sets, but he's shaping up to be a beast! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/9893ff5bb20bfe9b08eb274cf89e420e15293aa8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/70af92c5e7dd53be3451b050021def9eeb85a7aa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/c20bc7992a90333e6efcb096bc10b6125f48f83b.jpg[/img]

[h3]More ːfh4trophyːteams[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/2f0255876ce123459eb662b2292dc64196f137a0.jpg[/img]
We’ll be adding the following teams this month:
[list]
     [*] Grim Bay Attackers;
     [*] Microhard Mutilators;
     [*] Insane Cults.
[/list]

[h3]RPO ːSocialPolicyːSystem[/h3]
You asked for it, and we’re delivering! Get ready for run-pass options (RPOs), along with improved Play Action plays that’ll fool your opponents like never before!

[h3]Feature ːcsgoxː[/h3]
We’ve been secretly working on a special feature for months. It’s not quite alpha yet, but we’re going to give our [b]Early Access[/b] players the first crack at it. Look for it around ːOrcHateː[b]Halloween[/b], and we’ll reveal all the details in our ːOrcHateː[b]Halloween[/b] ːtelegramːnewsletter.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857262/ddeb31a3ad6968955c4557de1964cee5b9c5a66f.jpg[/img]
Only the players in our [b][i]MFL2[/i] Steam Early Access[/b] program will be the ones to first experience it and help us refine it.

[h2]Q&ːcsgoaː – Your Questions, Answered![/h2]
[b]Q: Which platforms is MFL2 coming to, and when?[/b]
ːcsgoaː: Fall of 2025 MFL2 will be on the following platforms:
[list]
[*] Xbox Series X;
[*] PlayStation®5;
[*] Steam;
[*] Nintendo Switch 2 (TBD) – We’re evaluating if it can run on the new Switch hardware!
[/list]

[b]Q: Will it be compatible with the Steam Deck?[/b]
ːcsgoaː: Absolutely! It wasn’t at first, but we heard from the [b][i]MFL2[/i] Steam[/b] community and our tech lead, Ivan worked some magic, and now it runs nice. We’re still planning more improvements!

[b]Q: What is (will be) the cost of Early Access, and what should players expect to encounter during Early Access?[/b]
ːcsgoaː: [b]Early Access[/b] is [b]$24.99[/b]ːpapermoneyː, and here’s what you’ll get:
[list]
[*] A fun game with minimal bugs;
[*] A complete visual overhaul with improved graphics;
[*] Unique player customizations (armor, hairstyles, tattoos, etc.);
[*] 16 playable teams, with more on the way;
[*] Multiplayer online and a 16-team single-player season;
[*] New Dirty Tricks and in-game boosts (SkillRoid injections);
[*] Dynasty Supreme mode coming after all 32 teams are created (targeting December).
[/list]

[b]Q: Are there plans for a physical copy to be made available like there was available for MFL1?[/b]
ːcsgoaː: TBD! We’ll need a publishing partner for a physical release, so stay tuned!

[b]Q: How much of a difference has the added player on the field made to the game in terms of diversity of play and new strategy available to players?[/b]
ːcsgoaː: The move to 8 players has made the game more dynamic, with a wider range of offensive strategies. From 4-receiver sets to 2 running backs, it’s added depth and made your Bruise Receiver (tight end) a major part of the action. Defenses are going to have their hands full!

[b]Q: With customization, will this include microtransactions and if so, will you be ensuring that microtransactions never give any form of gameplay advantage?[/b]
ːcsgoaː: No way! Microtransactions, if we have them, will only be cosmetic. Gameplay will always be based on skill and strategy. No pay-to-win here!

[b]Q: When can we expect Mutant Hockey League, and will you follow with other sports?[/b]
ːcsgoaː: Trust me, no one wants MHL more than I do. But first, we need to get MFL2 out the door. If it’s successful, we might just skate our way to Mutant Hockey League next!

That’s it for this edition of the MFL Fanatics Newsletter! Thanks for being part of the MFL family and sticking with us through thick and thin. We’ll see you on the field!


Warmest Regards,
[b]Michael Mendheim[/b]
President / Creative Director
[b]Digital Dreams Entertainment Inc.[/b]

Hello everyone,

We've added [b]Steam Deck[/b] to our list of target platforms, and this means that from now on, we will be dedicating resources to ensure you have an enjoyable gaming experience on it. Today's patch should improve the game's performance on the [b]Steam Deck[/b] and here is list of all changes:
[list]
[*] Created a separate "[b]Steam Deck[/b]" graphics profile;
[*] Improved memory consumption;
[*] Support on-screen keyboard.
[/list]

Please be aware that we are testing everything on the [b]"[u]vanilla[/u]" Steam OS[/b]. 
If you have a different setup and encounter issues, please let us know in the dedicated thread here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1657320/discussions/2/4330853251139980766/
